nativeDependencies.name: glslang
nativeDependencies.license: Multiple permissive licenses; full LICENSE.txt preserved

provenance.adoptedArtifact: Already converted ncnn graph/weights committed in official nihui/rife-ncnn-vulkan repository; copied byte-for-byte without conversion or quantization.
provenance.conversionLimitation: Upstream converted artifact does not publish a hash of its original PyTorch checkpoint or exact conversion command. No claim is made to reconstruct training or reconvert the model.
licenseBasis: The exact graph and weights are tracked files at the pinned revision under models/rife-v4.6, inside the repository governed by its root MIT LICENSE (Copyright (c) 2020 nihui). No subtree license, model exclusion or separate artifact terms occurs in this revision.
Pinned README explicitly states: This package includes all the binaries and models required; its model table lists rife-v4.6 / upstream 4.6.
Model introduction is a commit in the same licensed repository, not an unrelated user checkpoint or an external download linked from the RIFE training repository.
provenance.scope: Redistribution basis is only these exact committed converted artifacts, with the full repository MIT notice preserved. It is not a blanket statement about other RIFE weights.

contract.input: Two same-size direct tightly packed RGB8 buffers, nonlinear known SDR BT.709 signal, normalized channelwise to [0,1]. No RGB/BGR swap.
contract.output: Same width/height RGB8, saturating rounded model output. Separate codec compression may be lossy.
contract.customLayer: rife.Warp (upstream warp.cpp and three Vulkan shaders)
contract.timestep: in2 is full spatial scalar map, arbitrary finite t in [0,1]; endpoints copy original and are not counted as inference.
contract.padding: Zero-pad right/bottom to next multiple of 32; crop each output row using its padded stride.
contract.precision: FP32 activations/storage/arithmetic; fp16/bf16/int8 disabled. Upstream binary retains upstream serialized weight representation.
contract.scaling: No full-frame pre-resize, UHD switch or tiling. Model internal learned flow pyramid includes 1/8,1/4,1/2 scales. Final composition uses original-resolution inputs.
contract.backend: Android requires Vulkan. CPU enabled only in host test executable.

modifications: New library/JNI integration uses upstream v4 graph directly, omitting desktop CLI/image codecs/TTA/UHD modes.
Native preprocessing checks allocations and crops padded output with correct row stride.
Checked model/graph/timestep operations and finite output validation; failures stop the job.
Patch pinned ncnn to propagate ignored Vulkan submit/model-upload errors; patch Warp to propagate shader/pipeline creation errors. Exact before/after hashes are in scripts/native-sources.json.

validation.hostInference: PASS: real bundled graph/weights on CPU host, synthetic 65x49, arbitrary t=.25/.5, exact t=0/1 endpoints; observed midpoint differs from simple blend. Not an Android/Vulkan/quality/performance acceptance result.
validation.hdr: UNSUPPORTED: upstream RGB8 model and app boundary do not preserve 10-bit/HDR signals.
validation.hostVulkanAvailability: UNAVAILABLE: vkCreateInstance failed -9; checked error propagated, no CPU fallback in requested Vulkan mode.
validation.hostVulkanSoftware: PASS: exact graph through Vulkan compute on Mesa llvmpipe software driver (LLVM 19.1.7); 65x49 at t=.25/.5. CPU midpoint identical; quarter max RGB8 difference1 in 3/9555 channel values. Not Android/physical GPU performance validation.

engineHashMethod: SHA-256 of canonical sorted JSON sourcePath:SHA256 map; NativeRife MODEL_HASH/ENGINE_HASH literal values normalized to <computed>. Dependency revisions, checksums and patches are included via scripts/native-sources.json.
